Interface IF_Server

All Superinterfaces:
Remote
All Known Implementing Classes:
Server
public interface IF_Server extends Remote
Server's Interface for ModelViewController pattern.
Interface for the methods that the Views call directly in order to establish the connection with the Controller.

  • Method Details

    • handleConnection

      void handleConnection(IF_GameView view) throws IOException
      Handle a Client connection.
      This method is called by the Clients in order to inform the Server of their connection.
      After the connection has been established successfully, the Client can create/connect to the Lobby.
      Pre: view != null
      Parameters:
      view - The Client instance of the IF_GameView.
      Throws:
      IOException - The connection cannot be established correctly.

    • createLobby

      void createLobby(IF_GameView view, int playersNumber, String lobbyCode) throws IOException
      Request to create a Lobby.
      This method is called by the Client in order to create a Lobby.
      the Server check if the number of Players and the Lobby Code are valid.
      Pre: view != null && lobbyCode != null
      Parameters:
      view - The Client instance of the IF_GameView.
      playersNumber - Number of Players for the Lobby.
      lobbyCode - Requested Lobby Code.
      Throws:
      IOException - The connection cannot be established correctly.

    • setNickname

      void setNickname(IF_GameView view, String nickname, String code) throws IOException
      Check the nickname of a Client.
      This method is invocated from each Client connecting to the lobby, and works as the Server-side counterpart to the method view.askNickname().
      If the nickname is valid (no duplicates), the Server connects the Client to the lobby.
      Pre: view != null && nickname != null && code != null
      Post: !\old(lobby.getClients().keySet().contains(nickname)) ==> lobby.getClients().keySet().contains(nickname)
      Parameters:
      view - The Client instance of the IF_GameView.
      nickname - Nickname of the Client.
      Throws:
      IOException - The connection cannot be established correctly.

    • ping

      void ping() throws IOException
      Heartbeat for the Server.
      This method is called by the Client in order to verify if the Server is still connected.
      Throws:
      IOException - The connection is no more established.
